title: Pretty cheap product
text:
Pretty cheap product. I know I paid very little for this rug but . . .
I love the colors/style. Their is literally no backing so it slides all over my hard wood. I'll have to buy some kind of taping to secure it. Not sure if that will be OK for the hard wood. Also, it refuses to lay completely flat at each end and I've tripped over the ends a few times. Even my 7# chihuahua slid the rug!!

description: Add a bold, dramatic layer to your interiors with the Viking Indoor Area Rug by Superior. Crafted from 100-percent Polypropylene, this family-friendly area rug can handle some of your most frequented areas of the home, including kitchens, family rooms, basements, and entryways. The versatile yet bold geometric trellis design will stand out amongst transitional, eclectic, or modern aesthetics. The low 0.31-rug thickness cleans easily, can easily fit under most doors, and allows chairs sitting atop this rug to slide easily. With a range of sizes and color options to choose from, this striking geometric design is sure to coordinate effortlessly with your surrounding decor.
